ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Discovery Activity Using Find - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "find" binary in a suspicious manner to perform discovery

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/find$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-4000.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-2000.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ 0777.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-222.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-o\\ w.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-o\\ x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-u\\=s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-perm\\ \\-g\\=s.*")))
